context: A physics lesson on atomic structure
purpose: Teach atomic structure; teach 物理/核/確立/低下/促進/不可能/すなわち/知的

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は物理の基礎、原子の構造を学びます。
lines.en: Today we learn physics basics — atomic structure.
lines.style: measured lecturer opening clearly, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 原子核の周りを電子が回るんですよね。
lines.en: Electrons orbit the atomic nucleus, right?
lines.style: engaged student confirming the model, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、この模型は二十世紀に確立されました。
lines.en: Yes, this model was established in the 20th century.
lines.style: lecturer giving historical grounding, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 温度が低下すると、動きはどうなりますか？
lines.en: When temperature falls, what happens to motion?
lines.style: curious teen probing a mechanism, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 遅くなります。逆に、熱は反応を促進します。
lines.en: It slows. Conversely, heat promotes reactions.
lines.style: lecturer explaining cause and effect, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔は観測が不可能だったんですよね。
lines.en: Observing it was impossible long ago, right?
lines.style: student appreciating the difficulty, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう、すなわち技術の進歩が理解を広げたのです。
lines.en: Right — that is, technical progress widened understanding.
lines.style: lecturer drawing the inference, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 物理って、知的好奇心を刺激しますね。
lines.style: inspired teen voicing wonder, tone holding steady through the whole line
